title: Puss in Boots
overview: After the old miller had died, his youngest son inherited just a cunning cat. The beast spent the last money of his master to buy himself boots and hat. Knowing that the king liked hazel-grouses the sly puss caught some of them, brought to the palace as a present and got a lavish gift from the king. And more! The sly animal managed to overpower the evil wizard and marry off his master with the king's daughter.
